title: Goma public-transport strike over the mayor’s yellow-paint rule
reason: The article was published on 1 February 2022 and dates the reported second day of the strike to Tuesday 1 February 2022; the action began Monday. It is outside the assigned February 2021 month.
notes: Kivu Nyota reports a citywide transport stoppage joined by citizen movements and drivers opposing the mayor’s yellow-paint order. It gives no attendance count or specific mass assembly. It mentions arrests and serious injuries as police confronted drivers enforcing the strike. The report is retained as an out-of-period exclusion, not a 2021 candidate or continuation.

title: Anti-Karega protest outside the Rwandan embassy in Kinshasa
reason: The opened report says participants objected to Rwanda’s ambassador’s conduct and records no separate demand to DRC authorities. The action is directed solely at a foreign government representative, outside the unit’s inclusion scope.
notes: Actualite.cd dates the protest to Feb 19 and reports police dispersal and several detentions. Attendance is unreported; tire burning appears in the account. The exclusion follows the documented target rule, not an attendance judgment.
